crossRefs.note: Abraham answered, “See now, I have taken it on myself to speak to the Lord, although I am dust and ashes.
He said, “Oh don’t let the Lord be angry, and I will speak. What if there are thirty found there?” He said, “I will not…
Brace yourself like a man, for I will question you, then you answer me!
“Now brace yourself like a man. I will question you, and you will answer me.

translations.web: You said, ‘Listen, now, and I will speak; I will question you, and you will answer me.’
translations.bsb: You said, ‘Listen now, and I will speak. I will question you, and you shall inform Me.’
translations.kjv: Hear, I beseech thee, and I will speak: I will demand of thee, and declare
translations.asv: Hear, I beseech thee, and I will speak; I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.
